issue_records.title: `let x = 1 #` ParseError
issue_records.body_excerpt:
```julia
julia> let x = 1
       x
       end
1

julia> let x = 1 #
ERROR: ParseError:
# Error @ REPL[2]:1:10
let x = 1 #
#        └ ── premature end of input
Stacktrace:
 [1] top-level scope
   @ none:1
```
from https://discourse.julialang.org/t/let-x-1-parseerror/130050?u=waltermadelim

issue_records.title: fix: skip zero-width error tokens in last_non_whitespace_byte
issue_records.body_excerpt:
to ensure that `let x = 1 # comment` is treated as an incomplete expression.

Fixes https://github.com/JuliaLang/JuliaSyntax.jl/issues/565.
